name: Hotel Sonne
beschreibung: The Hotel Sonne is located in the center of Ischgl directly at the valley station of the Silvretta-Bahn. The rooms combine traditional Tiroler elements with modern amenities and have balconies with mountain views. The culinary offerings include a breakfast buffet and an evening menu with regional products. The wellness area includes an indoor pool, saunas, and relaxation rooms. A ski depot and ski boot dryer are available in winter. The location directly on the piste and in the pedestrian zone makes the hotel usable for active vacationers in both seasons. Parking spaces are available in the hotel's own garage for a fee.
